commits: 7e81ff7 LK-91: bound step-panel labels before the command column
result.summary:
Both step-panel renderers now bound the row label on both sides. The label is anchored LEFT at LABEL_X (26) and RIGHT 8px short of the command's LEFT edge, with SetJustifyH("LEFT") and SetWordWrap(false), so a long label ends in an ellipsis instead of running under the command column. This applies to LibKa0s/SimPanel.lua (anchorLabel in paintRow) and LibKa0s/PerfPanel.lua (makeStepButton). The command keeps its natural width at the right. A Sim row with an empty or nil command runs the label to the row's right inset (-CMD_PAD). The label is re-anchored only when the command appears or goes. The bound comes from anchors, not a width, so a resize widens it.

Tests were written first and confirmed red. New tests:
- 3 in tests/test_sim_panel_render.lua: two anchors and wrap off, the empty-command inset and re-anchoring, resize with no fixed width.
- 1 in tests/test_sim_panel.lua: the tooltip's first line is the full long label.
- 1 in tests/test_perf_panel.lua: anchors and wrap off, checked under the sim fixture's recorder.

tests/fixture_sim_panel.lua's region gained ClearAllPoints.

Versioning:
- SimPanel keeps minor 5, already bumped in the unpublished v1.76.0.
- PerfPanel moves 7 to 8, because 7 shipped in v1.75.x. The Perf key moves 15.1.1.7 to 15.1.1.8.
- Ripples: a new docs/api/Perf/version-15.1.1.8-docs.md; 15.1.1.7 marked superseded with a 'Moving to' section; a docs/api/README row; members-15.1.1.8.json via tools/gen-api-members.lua; the README Perf row.
- CHANGELOG v1.76.0 version block and a new section; a Row layout bullet in Sim 2.3.5's document; docs/test-cases.md regenerated (2578); CLAUDE.md band figures re-measured.

The local annotated tag v1.76.0 moved from 9949368df8db12e51c9c51e403738989c87709a5 to 7e81ff7e989aacef8063bfd56e4fcc5742157667, which is HEAD, and was not pushed. Both shas are appended to Ka0sAddonsCommonTasks/docs/2026-10-23-SIM_PREVIEW_MODE_STRIPS/99_EXECUTION_RECORD.md, which is not committed. Smoke check SM-LK-1 is the owner's. LibKa0s has no smoke-doc file, so it lives in the bundle.

result.summary: I reproduced the stall headlessly on the kit clock. Ledger.lua settled a reconcile pass only when it recorded a movement. A complete movement that the capture gate refuses (blacklist, quality threshold, uncached item under a threshold, excluded store, Track toggle) was treated as a one-sided change, so the baseline was held for the full 6 s SETTLE_TIMEOUT. During that hold the sim gate (Ledger._settleSince) stayed closed, and the next step played 6.5 s late instead of about 1 s. The owner's SavedVariables blacklist 6948 (Hearthstone) and 241325, and the sim pool draws real bag items sorted by id. A run that moves the Hearthstone therefore stalls exactly like this. That link is inferred from SavedVariables; SIM-13 checks it in game. Fix: reconcileStore now also returns the number of movements it found. Reconcile sums both counts, and settleBaseline settles when found > 0 or the world is unchanged. Reconcile still returns the number of rows written. Tests were written first and were red for this cause before the fix: a test_ledger_settling case (a blacklisted deposit settles at once) and three test_sim_e2e pacing cases (bank default; item C blacklisted, red at 6.50 s; flask uncached under threshold 1, red at 6.50 s). Each pacing case asserts every step plays within stepDelay + GATE_POLL of the step before. Doc changes: data-flow.md, a new smoke check SIM-13 (SM-BL-14, pending, listed under Pending sign-off) plus its index row, docs/test-cases.md regenerated (Total 1425), and the README tests badge updated to match.
result.deviations: The spec's lead hypothesis was an item-info load for the uncached flask. It does not apply at the owner's settings: with the default quality threshold of 0, nothing waits on item info, and the default headless run already paced at 1 s. Item info only matters under a non-zero threshold, where it is the same refused-movement case, so the fix follows spec step 3 (settle timing) and adds no priming at prepare. One behaviour change follows from the fix: under a threshold, an uncached item's move is now refused at once. Before, a re-diff later in the hold could still record it. This matches GateReason's documented intent. The repo has no CHANGELOG file, and its README Version History is written at bump time, so I added no Unreleased entry and did no version bump. The sim pacing cases live in test_sim_e2e.lua, so no new suite was registered.
